diagram_math_checks.evidence: The cohomological Serre supplier statement and transgression definition fix d_r:E_r^(p,q)->E_r^(p+r,q-r+1). The three arrows are respectively (0,1)->(2,0), (2,1)->(4,0), and (4,1)->(6,0), with labels u->x, ux->x^2, ux^2->x^3. No horizontal or reversed differential is drawn.

Local step 3.1 sets x=d2(u). The multiplicative supplier gives the total-degree Leibniz sign; d2(x^k)=0 on the bottom row, so d2(ux^k)=d2(u)x^k-u d2(x^k)=x^(k+1). The base degree is even, so no additional tensor/Koszul sign occurs. All three maps are the source isomorphisms. The caption fixes x by u and makes no independent positive-orientation assertion.

Local steps 3.1 and 4.1 give x^(n+1)=0. In the pictured n=3 case ux^3 at (6,1) has prospective target (8,0)=0, so no nonzero arrow leaves it. Every other top generator maps isomorphically to the next bottom generator. Only 1 at (0,0) and ux^3 at (6,1) survive, of total degrees 0 and 7. For r>=3 the two rows give no nonzero outgoing or incoming differential, agreeing with the sphere abutment.

Caption states precisely 0<=k<n, source (2k,1) and target (2k+2,0), and the terminal ux^n. For n=1 there are two columns 0,2, exactly u->x and survivors 1,ux in degrees 0,3, as verified in local step 4.1. It does not incorrectly claim all differentials vanish.

The original full Verification steps 1.1,1.2,2.1,3.1,4.1 are unchanged byte-for-byte and establish every illustrated relation before the final Remarks. No statement, definition, dependency or supplier repair is needed.
